label: judge-viability-31-38
system: You compare two consumer app ideas on ONE dimension at a time. You are not choosing what you would build; you are judging the dimension asked for. Length is not quality: the two entries are rendered in an identical template and any difference in wording length is an artefact. Output JSON only.
user:
DIMENSION — viability:
Which is more likely to reach $10,000 monthly revenue within two years on a budget under $50,000? Weigh the margin at realistic conversion, whether the distribution loop actually turns, and whether anyone comes back for the second month.

Answer these checks for EACH entry first, as yes or no:
  q1 names a specific population with a specific trigger moment
  q2 the enabling capability genuinely changed recently
  q3 something very close already ships
  q4 the distribution loop turns without advertising spend
  q5 there is a reason to open it again in week two

{
  "title": "Rota Sleep",
  "for_whom": "nurses and paramedics on rotating 12-hour shift patterns",

  "mechanic": "passive_tracking",
  "wedge": "One job only: when a daytime sleep block lands in HealthKit, wake on background delivery, rescore it against the shift the person is actuall",
  "why_now": "Same-day rescoring of a daytime sleep block was impossible while the phone could not wake itself on new sensor data and every score cost a cloud round trip, and",
  "money": "freemium_subscription",
  "growth": "community_embed",
  "price_month": null,
  "build_cost_usd": null
}
